features.title: Why choose Tracify?
features.subtitle: One click and zero effort to find anyone's location across the globe
features.feature1Desc: While the phone's owner will be informed of a location request, the requester's identity remains confidential. All geolocation requests are made with respect to privacy, and transmitted data is encrypted for security.
features.feature2Desc: There's no software to install on your phone or the targeted device. Everything operates remotely! Just input the phone number you wish to track. As soon as the SMS recipient provides consent, you'll have immediate access.
features.feature3Desc: Tracify works with all networks worldwide. However, successful tracking requires the phone to be on, service availability, and the SMS recipient's explicit consent to share their location.
features.feature4Desc: Tracify seamlessly supports both iOS and Android mobile devices. As long as you have the phone number and the individual's explicit approval to track, you can locate them using our service.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Here you can find all the answers to the questions we are most often asked about our mobile geolocation service, Tracify.
faq.a1: Tracify is a mobile geolocation service that allows you to locate any phone number worldwide. Our service works by sending an SMS to the target phone requesting location sharing consent. Once consent is given, you receive the precise GPS coordinates.
faq.q2: Is it even legal to use the Tracify phone number tracker?
faq.a2: Yes, Tracify is completely legal because it requires explicit consent from the person being tracked. The recipient must actively agree to share their location by responding to the SMS request. We comply with all privacy regulations and data protection laws.
faq.a3: Tracify supports all major mobile networks worldwide. Whether the target phone uses GSM, CDMA, LTE, or 5G networks, our service can send location requests to any valid phone number.
faq.q4: Can I track the location of the phone number if I don't know its model?
faq.a4: Absolutely! You don't need to know the phone model, manufacturer, or operating system. All you need is the phone number. Our system automatically handles all the technical details regardless of the device type.
faq.q5: Does Tracify support both iOS and Android operated mobile devices?
faq.a5: Yes, Tracify works with both iOS (iPhone) and Android devices. Our SMS-based location request system is compatible with any smartphone that can receive text messages and has location services available.
faq.q6: How fast can Tracify find the location of a phone number?
faq.a6: Once the SMS recipient consents to share their location, you'll receive the coordinates almost instantly. The total time depends on how quickly the recipient responds to the location request.
faq.q7: How to track a phone number without physical access to the target device?
faq.a7: Simply enter the phone number in our system, customize your message, and we'll send an SMS requesting location consent. Everything is done remotely - no physical access to the target device is ever required.
faq.q8: Can I track someone by cell phone number?
faq.a8: Yes, but only with their explicit consent. Tracify sends a location request via SMS, and tracking only occurs when the recipient agrees to share their location. This ensures privacy and legal compliance.
